description: This file defines the LaunchAgentManager enum which provides static methods to manage macOS launch agents, including enabling, disabling, checking status, and generating plist contents for launch agents.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Checks if the launch agent is currently active by running 'launchctl print' and evaluating the result.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent based on the 'enabled' parameter by writing or removing the plist and orchestrating 'launchctl' commands.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Writes a launch agent plist file with the specified bundle path.

methods.name: plistContents
methods.description: Generates the content of the plist file as a string with embedded parameters.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Runs the 'launchctl' command asynchronously with provided arguments.
